title: Prop rows still show the edge % when STALE (only grade is hidden)
steps: Code reading. app/src/components/prop-row.tsx renders `pct(r.ev)` outside any `.edge-only` wrapper; globals.css hides only `.edge-only` when `.is-stale`.
Same pattern in game/[id]/page.tsx MarketRow. Not reproducible on demo data because the stale threshold is stretched.
expected: Stale rows have no grade or edge (README product rule): the edge % is hidden too.
actual: Dimmed row still prints e.g. '+10.0%' next to 'STALE'; filterFeed deliberately keeps `ev` on stale rows.
suspected_area: prop-row.tsx / MarketRow: wrap edge % in .edge-only (or show a dash when stale). Suspected, not observed live
